_comment: REAL maze snapshot 2026-11-08 (organizers changed the maze vs COURSE_MAP), from the two hand-carried skybeta-05 loops 20261108-010430_manual / 010807_manual: node half320 stereo depth + VIO, occgrid.py grids of each flight's first 10 m of travel (VIO drift <= ~0.3 m), walls fitted in both flights; corridor = the route both carriers walked, checked with gridplan A* (>= 0.387 m from every measured wall); tunnel from perception/tunnel.py on the rectified frames (both flights agree to ~4 cm). Start frame = start mark + start heading. Measured: walls (except 'barrier' west part), corridor, tunnel entry/axis. NOT verified (kept from the official map, see _unverified): fence N/W/S, tunnel length, window, landing pad, wall crossing, chicane, gate_b, boulders, landing routes, C2_north, W4. mission-REPORT.md section 33.

tunnel._measured: entry centre (f -1.28 +-0.04, l -4.82 +-0.03, up 0.71), axis 180 +-8 deg, hoop radius ~0.78 (detector), both flights; length not measured
tunnel._entry_fix_20261108: real entry hoop at f ~ -0.59 (tunnel_servo, both walks); -1.28 was the 2nd hoop

gate_b._comment: Gate B = open gap x 10.5 ft, y 8.1-11.5 (C2 north end - barrier). exit_m 0.45: W4 stands 1.13 m beyond the gate centre. 'after' = landing route around W4's SOUTH end (>= 0.6 m from it), then the landing observe-pose search takes over.

_comment_checkpoint4: checkpoint4: 'gate_b' (default when gate_b is given: open gap, no detector) or 'window'.
_comment_walls: walls: board lines from COURSE_MAP.md (replica/layout.py v4 MAZE_WALLS), optional. A stereo cluster on / near one (radius + 0.35 m + walls_tol_m) is never discounted as a net phantom (round B: thin board ends).
